memorii.rezumat: ALTUL (medie) —
memorii.detalii:
De la: DeepInfra <newsletter@deepinfra.com>
ID Gmail: 1a143958566e4e50
Thread: 1a143958566e4e50
Data: Fri, 16 Oct 2026 07:19:38 +0000
Subiect: October at DeepInfra: 50B tokens + agent tools

Conținut:
Meet us at GTC Berlin, get 50B free tokens through DeepStart, and build agents with Hosted Agents and Sandboxes.  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://deepinfra.com October 2026

A few things we’d like to share with you this October: we’ll be at GTC Berlin next week, startups can now get 50 billion free tokens through DeepStart, and developers have two new ways to build and run agents on DeepInfra.
GTC Berlin


** Come say hello at GTC Berlin.
------------------------------------------------------------

Less than a week away! We’re coming to Berlin for this year’s NVIDIA GTC, October 20–22. Find us in the Exhibit Hall at booth 7032—swing by to meet the team, talk through your inference setup, or just say hi.
https://www.nvidia.com/en-eu/gtc/

GTC Berlin details → (https://www.nvidia.com/en-eu/gtc/)
DeepStart


** DeepStart now comes with 50 billion free tokens.
------------------------------------------------------------

We’ve upgraded our DeepStart program. It now includes 50 billion free tokens, usable across all open-source models hosted on DeepInfra. Companies founded in the last two years that have raised between $250K and $10M are eligible to apply. The tokens expire one year after they are granted.
https://deepinfra.com/deepstart

Apply to DeepStart → (https://deepinfra.com/deepstart)
Hosted Agents + Sandboxes


** Build and run agents on DeepInfra.
------------------------------------------------------------

Hosted Agents give you a fully managed, open-source AI agent that’s ready in minutes, already connected to DeepInfra and billed hourly only while it runs.

Pick OpenClaw for a web dashboard that works well for teams, or Hermes if you prefer the terminal over SSH.

When an agent needs to execute code, Sandboxes provide an isolated Linux microVM with its own kernel and hardware-level isolation. Start one with a single API call, pay by the second, and pay nothing while it’s stopped.

Meet Hosted Agents → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/agents/introduction)

Explore Sandboxes → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/sandboxes/overview)

Stay tuned for more, and take care.

— The DeepInfra team

Conținut:
Meet us at GTC Berlin, get 50B free tokens through DeepStart, and build agents with Hosted Agents and Sandboxes.  ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌ ‌

https://deepinfra.com October 2026

A few things we’d like to share with you this October: we’ll be at GTC Berlin next week, startups can now get 50 billion free tokens through DeepStart, and developers have two new ways to build and run agents on DeepInfra.
GTC Berlin


** Come say hello at GTC Berlin.
------------------------------------------------------------

Less than a week away! We’re coming to Berlin for this year’s NVIDIA GTC, October 20–22. Find us in the Exhibit Hall at booth 7032—swing by to meet the team, talk through your inference setup, or just say hi.
https://www.nvidia.com/en-eu/gtc/

GTC Berlin details → (https://www.nvidia.com/en-eu/gtc/)
DeepStart


** DeepStart now comes with 50 billion free tokens.
------------------------------------------------------------

We’ve upgraded our DeepStart program. It now includes 50 billion free tokens, usable across all open-source models hosted on DeepInfra. Companies founded in the last two years that have raised between $250K and $10M are eligible to apply. The tokens expire one year after they are granted.
https://deepinfra.com/deepstart

Apply to DeepStart → (https://deepinfra.com/deepstart)
Hosted Agents + Sandboxes


** Build and run agents on DeepInfra.
------------------------------------------------------------

Hosted Agents give you a fully managed, open-source AI agent that’s ready in minutes, already connected to DeepInfra and billed hourly only while it runs.

Pick OpenClaw for a web dashboard that works well for teams, or Hermes if you prefer the terminal over SSH.

When an agent needs to execute code, Sandboxes provide an isolated Linux microVM with its own kernel and hardware-level isolation. Start one with a single API call, pay by the second, and pay nothing while it’s stopped.

Meet Hosted Agents → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/agents/introduction)

Explore Sandboxes → (https://docs.deepinfra.com/sandboxes/overview)

Stay tuned for more, and take care.

— The DeepInfra team
